scope: Local synthetic WebSocket peers against Spring v8 and SQLite; no Connector, PTY, React, remote network or production capacity claim.
histogramEncoding: nonzeroBuckets entries are [upper bound in ms, count]; bucket 1001 means >1000 ms, omitted buckets have zero samples. p95UpperMs null means empty or overflow.
notes: Full run used repetitive compressible payload and default WebSocket compression negotiation; reported rates are application payload before compression, not TCP throughput. Individual negotiation was not recorded; a later handshake with the same JAR confirmed permessage-deflate.
Recovery run explicitly disabled compression and recorded negotiatedExtensions.
All failures are retained. Initial slow-consumer failed to induce the intended fault. Replay failures are product findings; larger recovery stages were stopped.
Full run manifest predates its snapshot commit; all included source hashes were verified against sourceSnapshotCommit. Recovery used a clean committed snapshot. Both used the identical immutable JAR.
flight covers timed load. recordingPressure includes warmup and post-load recovery. Two pressure counters may describe the same dropped frame.
Forced GC diagnostics and release cooldown are outside timed traffic. CPU fraction is relative to the whole machine. RSS is not heap.
